def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize text labels
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({'nan': None})
    # numeric columns stored as text
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix out-of-range body mass: values far above 6500 g are assumed to be in milligrams
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    d = d[d['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]
    means = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in means.items()}
